gen-gf-paprika-gf-prompt: Loud, loose, and sure of itself. Paprika is the one for making a statement, while Prompt, a plain sans with oversized small letters, quietly handles the everyday reading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-puritan: Puritan comes in rounded and friendly, its sans-serif letters staying open toward the side. Puritan's softness against Paprika's scattered, commanding capitals-for-lowercase look is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-questrial: Modern and a touch stencil-flat, Questrial gives the body a tall, single-weight line beneath Paprika's expressive heading. And where Paprika sprawls with lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals, Questrial stays tidy and crisp.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-radio-canada: Paprika makes its entrance with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Radio Canada follows in unshaded, pressure-free lines, a sans with clear openings at every curve, so the loud heading gets a quiet partner.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-radio-canada-big: Counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Radio Canada Big, a sans with a tall x-height and terminals standing clear of the stem, gives a long stretch of text a smooth, ballpoint-plain texture.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-readex-pro: Paprika arrives with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Readex Pro, a sans with broad terminal gaps and uniform weight, would sit nicely a few sizes down, giving the heading plenty of room to stand out.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-roboto: Scattered, commanding letters with lowercase that fills the line like capitals mark Paprika's look. Roboto, a plain sans, can stay modest and generous-mouthed beneath it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-saira: Paprika stands out with letters scattered at a distance. Make it small and that swagger fades, while Saira, a plain sans with see-through s shapes and tall rounded forms, would feel too big if enlarged.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sono: Ascenders that barely clear the x-height give Love Ya Like A Sister a squat, bold look. It earns its keep big and brief, while Sono follows in sans-serif letters that are tall, widely spaced, and gently ajar.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-stack-sans-headli: Stately, with roomy sidebearings and a high midline. Stack Sans Headline, a plain sans with a monoline skeleton and wide gaps, lets Metamorphous's soft thick-to-slim shifts take the spotlight.
